name: table-preview
title: Table Preview
description: A table of the app's to look at, copy and download, framed as a code block: its title and size, a button to copy it as text a spreadsheet takes, a menu to download it as CSV or Markdown, and a full-screen view with its heading row kept at the top. It scrolls sideways where it is wider, by keyboard too, faded at the edges; long cells wrap, short ones stay one line, a column of numbers to the end; a cell's rendering (e.g. a search's matches) and where a download goes may be the app's. Made of shadcn's Table, Dialog and DropdownMenu, in the code block's frame. It opens as DialogContent's size="full".
